create_PolarsDataFrame: create a PolarsDataFrame from a polars DataFrame using the interchange protocol
test_dataframe_dunder: test the __dataframe__ dunder method with allow_copy parameter on PolarsDataFrame
test_num_columns_num_rows_num_chunks: test num_columns, num_rows, and num_chunks methods on PolarsDataFrame
test_get_column_by_name: test get_column and get_column_by_name methods to retrieve columns from PolarsDataFrame
test_select_columns_by_name: test select_columns and select_columns_by_name to subset columns from PolarsDataFrame
test_get_chunks: test get_chunks to iterate over DataFrame chunks with optional chunk count limit
test_get_chunks_zero_copy: test get_chunks with allow_copy=False to verify CopyNotAllowedError on unevenly chunked columns
